title: ‘Birdman’ Takes Top Prize at Oscars
main_content:
“Birdman” won the top prize at the 87th Academy Awards, a night of firsts for many of the nominees and the show’s host which proved predictable as heavy favorites won in all the major categories.

First-time host Neil Patrick Harris opened the night with a quip about the lack of diversity among the nominees for the film industry’s highest honors and later came out in his underwear in a spoof of best picture favorite “Birdman.”

Mexican filmmaker Alejandro G. Inarritu won the most coveted awards of the night: the Oscar for best director and best picture for “Birdman,” his darkly satirical take on show business.

It was the first Academy Award for Inarritu, 51, whose film stars Michael Keaton as a washed-up, former superhero actor trying to make an improbable comeback with his own Broadway play.

Wes Anderson’s colorful caper, “The Grand Budapest Hotel” proved popular among the 6,100 members of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences who vote for the Oscars, winning four awards on its nine nominations.

“Whiplash,” the independent film about an aspiring jazz drummer and his tough mentor from young director Damien Chazelle, won three Oscars.​

Eddie Redmayne won the Oscar for Best Performance by an Actor in a Leading role for “The Theory of Everything” in which he portrayed physicist Stephen Hawking. The win robbed “Birdman” lead and former “Batman” actor Michael Keaton of a big comeback moment.

Five-time nominee Julianne Moore won best actress for her portrayal of a woman suffering from early onset Alzheimer’s in ”Still Alice.”​

Patricia Arquette won the Oscar for Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role for “Boyhood” in which she played a single mother struggling to bring up two children.

It was the first Oscar win for Arquette, 46, who swept the movie awards this season for playing the ups and downs of an everyday mom in the independent coming-of-age drama.

questions.question: Why was the show predictable?
options: Because it featured only first-time nominees.
Due to heavy favorites winning in all the major categories.
As Neil Patrick Harris had a scripted routine.
Because there were no surprises during the performances.
questions.answer: Due to heavy favorites winning in all the major categories.

questions.question: What was the theme of Neil Patrick Harris’s opening joke?
options: The extravagant outfits worn by the nominees.
The political issues prevalent in Hollywood.
The lack of diversity among the nominees.
The representation of independent films at the Oscars.
questions.answer: The lack of diversity among the nominees.

questions.question: How is the movie “Birdman” described in the text?
options: As a light-hearted comedy about theater.
As a darkly satirical take on show business.
As a documentary about superhero movies.
As a romantic drama focusing on family dynamics.
questions.answer: As a darkly satirical take on show business.
